newsitem.title: USA: Alaska Apollo raises outstanding shrs.
newsitem.headline: Alaska Apollo raises outstanding shrs.

text.p: Alaska Apollo Resources Inc said on Wednesday it increased its outstanding shares by 15 percent to 8,926,522 from 7,742,710.
The proceeds of $419,049 were used for the company's working capital and to fund an employee stock plan. The Company has 20,000,000 shares authorized.
Company employees received 204,000 of the newly issued shares valued at $0.38 per share or $77,520.
The remainder of the increase in shares was issued for a combination of private placement shares and compensation for professional services in lieu of cash, a company spokesman said.
